paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss Ratio and TFLOPs for various models. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs", has a logarithmic scale, a value range of $10^7$ to $10^9$, and tick labels at irregular intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)", has a linear scale, a value range of 94 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot contains five lines: a purple line for "Vanilla" with no markers and a solid line style; an orange line for "SepLLM (n=64)" with no markers and a solid line style; a blue line for "SepLLM (n=128)" with no markers and a solid line style; a green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)" with no markers and a solid line style; and a red line for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" with no markers and a solid line style. The purple line starts and remains at approximately 100% across the x-axis. The orange line starts at approximately 98.5% at $10^7$ TFLOPs and reaches approximately 99.5% at $10^8$ TFLOPs before remaining steady. The blue line starts at approximately 97% at $10^7$ TFLOPs and reaches approximately 99.5% at $3 \cdot 10^8$ TFLOPs before remaining steady. The green line starts at approximately 98% at $10^7$ TFLOPs and reaches approximately 99.5% at $10^8$ TFLOPs before remaining steady. The red line starts at approximately 94% at $10^7$ TFLOPs, increases to approximately 99% at $3 \cdot 10^8$ TFLOPs, then declines to approximately 98.5% at $9 \cdot 10^8$ TFLOPs.
